shortBio.en: Sumner / Hook / Morris + Gillian Gilbert; post-punk into club electronics.
shortBio.zh: Sumner / Hook / Morris + Gillian Gilbert；后朋克进入俱乐部电子。

body.en:
Formed 1980 after Ian Curtis's death. Early Factory Records singles (Blue Monday) and Power, Corruption & Lies (1983) fused sequenced bass, Hook's high melodic basslines, and Sumner's dry vocal.

Bridge page for Joy Division → dancefloor continuity. Catalog shows how post-punk personnel adopted drum machines without abandoning song form.
body.zh:
Ian Curtis 去世后于 1980 年组建。早期 Factory 单曲（Blue Monday）与 Power, Corruption & Lies（1983）融合音序低音、Hook 的高音旋律贝斯与 Sumner 的干人声。

Joy Division → 舞池连续性的桥页。目录展示后朋克人事如何采用鼓机而不放弃歌曲形式。

whyMatters.en: Post–Joy Division Manchester band; same core players plus synth/bass-dance grammar from Movement (1981) through Technique (1989).
whyMatters.zh: Joy Division 之后的曼彻斯特乐队；自 Movement（1981）到 Technique（1989），同一核心成员加上合成器/舞曲贝斯语法。

note.en: Joy Division outtake as debut—Sumner inherits Curtis lyric, post-punk continuity.
note.zh: Joy Division 遗作作 debut——Sumner 继承 Curtis 歌词，后朋克连续。

note.en: Oberheim DMX + sequenced bass—best-selling 12-inch, club grammar enters post-punk.
note.zh: Oberheim DMX + 音序低音——最畅销 12 寸，俱乐部语法进入后朋克。

note.en: Synth-pop polish on Technique—dry Sumner vocal over programmed groove.
note.zh: Technique 上 synth-pop 抛光——干 Sumner 人声叠 programmed groove。

body.en:
Remaining Joy Division members rename after Curtis's May 1980 death. Ceremony (1981) is a Curtis lyric set to new music—post-punk grief without dissolution.

Movement (1981) stays close to Joy Division's monochrome; Gillian Gilbert joins on keys.

Sumner moves to frontman/guitar; Hook's bass stays high on the neck, melodic not root-locked.
body.zh:
Joy Division 余部在 Curtis 1980 年 5 月去世后改名。Ceremony（1981）是 Curtis 歌词配新曲——后朋克哀悼而不解散。

Movement（1981）贴近 Joy Division 单色；Gillian Gilbert 加入键盘。

Sumner 转主唱/吉他；Hook 贝斯仍高音区、旋律化而非锁根音。

body.en:
Blue Monday (1983) uses Oberheim DMX drum machine and sequenced bass—Factory's die-cut sleeve costs exceed single revenue.

Power, Corruption & Lies adds Age of Consent and The Village—synth pads meet Hook bass hooks.

Low-Life (1985) and Brotherhood refine the electronic/post-punk hybrid for US college radio.
body.zh:
Blue Monday（1983）用 Oberheim DMX 鼓机与音序低音——Factory 模切封套成本超单曲收入。

Power, Corruption & Lies 加 Age of Consent 与 The Village——合成器 pad 遇 Hook 贝斯钩。

Low-Life（1985）与 Brotherhood 为美国 college radio 精炼电子/后朋克混合。

body.en:
Technique (1989) records in Ibiza—True Faith and Fine Time add house-adjacent programming to the catalog.

Hook's bass style (high, melodic, chorus-heavy) defines the band's silhouette for 27 years.

Hook exits 2007; Sumner/Morris/Gilbert continue—post-punk core survives lineup fracture.
body.zh:
Technique（1989）于 Ibiza 录音——True Faith 与 Fine Time 为目录加 house 邻近 programming。

Hook 贝斯风格（高音、旋律、多 chorus）定义乐队 27 年剪影。

Hook 2007 年离队；Sumner/Morris/Gilbert 继续——后朋克核心在阵容断裂后存活。
